verdict.rationale: Attio ships AI agents (Ask Attio, workflow agents), so letting those agents consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the pack only documents Attio acting as an MCP server for outside AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, which is the opposite direction and is not credited here. Nothing shows users can connect third-party MCP servers so Attio's AI can call their tools, and the SDK's HTTP and workflow-block extensibility is not MCP.
